description: Add bounded reusable hearing protection, trap-door wedging, and loaded-sack route recognition while composing ahead of existing material and underground authorities

    (IN WEST-OF-HOUSE)

    (ADJECTIVE LOOSE FIELD FIST SIZED)
    (DESC "loose field stone")
    (LDESC "A fist-sized loose stone rests in the grass.")

replacements.new:
<OBJECT FIELD-STONE
    (IN WEST-OF-HOUSE)
    (SYNONYM ROCK STONE)
    (ADJECTIVE LOOSE FIELD FIST SIZED)
    (DESC "loose field stone")
    (LDESC "A fist-sized loose stone rests in the grass.")
    (FLAGS TAKEBIT WEAPONBIT)
    (SIZE 6)
    (ACTION PLAYER-INGENUITY-FIELD-STONE-F)>

<OBJECT EARMUFFS
    (IN ATTIC)
    (SYNONYM EARMUFFS MUFFS PROTECTORS PROTECTION)
    (ADJECTIVE BATTERED INDUSTRIAL HEARING EAR SAFETY)
    (DESC "battered industrial earmuffs")
    (LDESC "A battered pair of industrial hearing protectors hangs from an old attic nail.")
    (FLAGS TAKEBIT WEARBIT)
    (SIZE 4)
    (ACTION PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-F)>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-WORN? ()
    <COND (<AND <IN? ,EARMUFFS ,WINNER> <FSET? ,EARMUFFS ,ONBIT>> <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-F ()
    <COND
      (<VERB? EXAMINE>
       <COND (<PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-WORN?>
              <TELL "The battered cups are clamped over your ears. Their cracked outer shells look old; the dense pads still make the rest of the world sound agreeably farther away." CR>)
             (T
              <TELL "These are old industrial hearing protectors: two battered hard cups joined by a springy band, with enough surviving padding to remain useful around serious noise." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<VERB? WEAR>
       <COND (<NOT <IN? ,EARMUFFS ,WINNER>>
              <PERFORM ,V?TAKE ,EARMUFFS>
              <COND (<NOT <IN? ,EARMUFFS ,WINNER>> <RTRUE>)>)>
       <COND (<PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-WORN?>
              <TELL "The hearing protectors are already sealed over your ears." CR>)
             (T
              <FSET ,EARMUFFS ,ONBIT>
              <TELL "You settle the battered cups over your ears. The room does not become silent; it becomes distant, padded, and noticeably less sharp." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<VERB? DROP>
       <COND (<PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-WORN?> <FCLEAR ,EARMUFFS ,ONBIT>)>
       <MOVE ,EARMUFFS ,HERE>
       <TELL "You lift the hearing protectors away and drop them. Ordinary sound returns at full strength." CR>
       <RTRUE>)
      (<VERB? LISTEN>
       <TELL "The cups themselves contribute almost nothing beyond a faint padded hush." CR>
       <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-FIELD-STONE-F ()
    <COND (<AND <VERB? TAKE> <FSET? ,FIELD-STONE ,ONBIT>>
           <FCLEAR ,FIELD-STONE ,ONBIT>
           <FCLEAR ,TRAP-DOOR ,TOUCHBIT>
           <TELL "You pull the field stone out from under the trap door. The door is free to close normally again." CR>
           <RFALSE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-TRAP-WEDGED? ()
    <COND (<AND <FSET? ,FIELD-STONE ,ONBIT> <IN? ,FIELD-STONE ,LIVING-ROOM>> <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-WEDGE-TRAP-DOOR ()
    <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,HERE ,LIVING-ROOM>>
           <TELL "You would need to be beside the House trap door to try that." CR>)
          (<NOT <IN? ,FIELD-STONE ,WINNER>>
           <TELL "You would first need to be holding the field stone." CR>)
          (<NOT <FSET? ,TRAP-DOOR ,OPENBIT>>
           <TELL "The trap door is closed. Open it before trying to put a wedge under its edge." CR>)
          (<PLAYER-INGENUITY-TRAP-WEDGED?>
           <TELL "The field stone is already jammed firmly under the trap door." CR>)
          (T
           <MOVE ,FIELD-STONE ,LIVING-ROOM>
           <FSET ,FIELD-STONE ,ONBIT>
           <FCLEAR ,TRAP-DOOR ,TOUCHBIT>
           <TELL "You work the fist-sized stone under the open trap door where the descending edge can bear against it. It is not elegant carpentry, but the door can no longer fall flush with the floor." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-SACK-BUNDLED? ()
    <COND (<AND <IN? ,SANDWICH-BAG ,WINNER>
                <FIRST? ,SANDWICH-BAG>
                <NOT <FSET? ,SANDWICH-BAG ,RMUNGBIT>>>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE PLAYER-INGENUITY-HOOK ()
    <COND
      (<AND <PLAYER-INGENUITY-EARMUFFS-WORN?>
            <VERB? LISTEN>
            <NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,EARMUFFS>>>
       <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,LOUD-ROOM>
                   <NOT <OR ,LOUD-FLAG <AND <NOT ,GATES-OPEN> ,LOW-TIDE>>>>
              <TELL "The padded cups turn the room's crushing roar into a broad, powerful pressure. You can tell the chamber is violently loud without surrendering your thoughts to it." CR>)
             (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEEP-CANYON> ,GATES-OPEN <NOT ,LOW-TIDE>>
              <TELL "The earmuffs blunt the canyon's water roar into a heavy distant wash. The protection helps, but subtle echoes and quiet details disappear with it." CR>)
             (T
              <TELL "The hearing protectors do exactly what they were built to do: most quiet detail is flattened into a padded murmur. You would need to remove them to listen closely." CR>)>
       <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UNDERGROUND-PHYSICALITY-ROOM? ()
